# How to Kiss Better

> howtokissbetter.com — Expert kissing advice, techniques, and a complete system for becoming an unforgettable kisser.

## About This Site

How to Kiss Better is an educational resource dedicated to the art and science of kissing. The site is authored by C.J. McKenna, author of *Kiss Perfect Now: A Master Class in Kissology*. It covers kissing techniques, first kiss advice, relationship intimacy, the science behind kissing, and common mistakes to avoid.

## The Book

**Kiss Perfect Now: A Master Class in Kissology** — A 200-page guide covering 16 chapters of kissing techniques, from the foundational Mirror Technique to advanced methods for maintaining passion in long-term relationships. Available as instant PDF download.
